findings.text: When you feel you have gathered enough of your attention
findings.what: You gather information or impressions, not 'enough of your attention'; the phrase does not say what has been gathered.
findings.fix: When you feel you have taken in enough

findings.text: They all lead to the same thing, which is how to maintain a presence of love
findings.what: Things do not 'lead to' a 'how to'; the intended sense is that they all come down to the same question.
findings.fix: They all come down to the same thing, which is how to maintain a presence of love

findings.text: some yarn, some bubbles, or some knots that you place beside you
findings.what: Bubbles cannot unwind or be placed as strands, unlike yarn and knots; a word like ribbon or thread seems meant.
findings.fix: some yarn, some ribbon, or some knots that you place beside you

notes: Part is mostly clean; the three findings are judgment calls and none is certain. Jokes (Larry, Cochrane medal) and the citations I could check (Phillips/Frederick 1995, Levine 2010/2012/2015, Levine/Kline, Nedergaard/Lupyan 2024) look right.
